constraints.ocl:
context Patient
inv: self.isInsured implies self.insurance <> null

context Hospital
inv: (self.departments->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null) and (self.departments->size() = 3)

context Hospital
inv: self.wards->any(x | x.floor > 2) <> null

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 6 and self.totalAmount <= 65

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 4 and self.totalAmount <= 6

context Doctor
inv: self.appointments->size() >= 1 and self.appointments->size() <= 2

context Department
inv: self.doctors->size() >= 1 and self.doctors->size() <= 1

context InsurancePolicy
inv: (self.patient.isInsured) and (self.validUntil.size() >= 6 implies self.validUntil.substring(1, 6) = 'AB')

context Department
inv: (self.nurses->one(x | x.shift <> '')) and (self.name <> '' and self.name.size() > 0)
